title: Instagram Story Image Maker | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn a product photo into a vertical Instagram Story image for your next offer. Choose a scene, leave room for your message, and download a still ready to post.
h1: Make a Vertical Instagram Story Image
lead: Put your product in a tall Story image that fits the phone screen. Choose a scene, leave space for your offer, and post a still you can make in minutes.
steps_h2: How to Make an Instagram Story Image in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Start with one product photo and finish with a vertical still image for your next Story.

steps.d: Upload a clear product photo or paste the product link. Check that the item is easy to recognize.
Choose a scene and leave clear space for the offer or short headline you want to add.
Preview the vertical image, check the product, and download the still for your Instagram or Facebook Story.

faq.q: What is an Instagram Story image for a product?
faq.a: It is a vertical still that shows your product in a Story-sized scene, with room for a short message or offer. For a moving ad, explore [creator-style video ads](page:video-ads).

faq.q: How many credits does a Story image cost?
faq.a: One image costs 24 credits. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. You see the cost before you generate.

faq.q: Can I start from my product page?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product link or upload your photo, then check the item before downloading the image.

faq.q: Can a person appear in my Story image?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a scene with a person holding or using the product, and keep the item clearly visible.

faq.q: What size works for Instagram Stories?
faq.a: A vertical 9:16 image fits the Story screen. Use the same format for a Facebook Story, and check the safe area before adding text.

faq.q: Can I add a price or sticker?
faq.a: Yes. Leave space in the image for your offer, then add a short price line or platform sticker before you post.

faq.q: Can I make a Story image without design experience?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear product photo, choose a scene, and check the result before downloading.

faq.q: Who should use this Story image template?
faq.a: Sellers who post product offers or launches in Instagram and Facebook Stories and need a quick vertical still.

faq.q: Can I use the product photo I already have?
faq.a: Yes. Start from a clear photo of the item you sell. Check its label, shape, and color in the finished Story.

faq.q: Can I use the image in a paid Story ad?
faq.a: Yes. Use the downloaded still in a paid Story placement or an organic post, and check the platform’s current ad rules.

faq.q: Why start from a Story template?
faq.a: The vertical layout gives your product room on a phone screen and leaves a clear place for your offer.

items.d: Upload the item you sell or paste its product page, then check the product in the finished still.
Choose a setting with a hand or person using the product, while keeping the item easy to recognize.
Keep a clear area for the price, offer, or short line you will add before posting.
Choose a background and crop that fit the product, then review the image before download.
Save the Story image without a watermark and add any final sticker in the social app.
Make a second vertical still from the same product photo when you want to test a different image or offer.
